messages:
Maria G: Quick heads-up — Syd2 region preflight. Wanted to surface where we are and call out a couple ownership gaps before we flip any routes.

Maria G: Milestones: staging peering ✅, smoke models ✅, routing policy applied to canary pool (50% traffic) ✅. Need KMS scope + egress review before full rollout.

Kevin L: Nice. On KMS: I started the key policy PR last night (RFC link: https://go/internal/syd2-kms). Waiting on privacy signoff for cross-region key usage.

Jordan P: Net-eng — can you confirm that the egress IPs for Syd2 are pinned? We still see a small NAT churn pattern on the staging logs.

net-eng: Checking. There was one autoscaling batch that reused ephemeral IPs. We pushed a static egress allocation to the pool; monitoring for 30m to confirm stability.

Maria G: Thanks. If static egress holds, we can proceed with the KMS tests. Who will own the residency mapping audit? Last time it was split between privacy and platform.

privacy-team: We can take the residency audit. Can you drop the dataset pointer and sample queries so we can validate reads/writes? Also need confirmation that logs sent to EU are filtered.

Maria G: Dropping sample query set and dataset pointer — /shared/syd2/residency-samples.csv. Also nginx access log filter is on the staging side; will share the rule.

Kevin L: Small FYI — found an edge-case in the route policy where fallbacks to global still hit a deprecated model variant. Pushed a fastfix to the policy repo:
```yaml
route_policy: syd2-edge
match: region == syd2
model_fallback: use_compatible_variant
timeout_ms: 1200
```
Please review, Jordan.

Jordan P: Reviewing now. Looks fine but can we make model_fallback explicit per customer tenancy? Don't want surprise regressions.

Maria G: Good catch. Action item: Kevin to make fallback tenant-aware, Jordan to code-review by EOD, Privacy to confirm KMS policy by EOD, Net-eng to confirm egress stability by +30m, Ops-bot to run final smoke at +1h.

Kevin L: On it — will update PR and add a test matrix.

ops-bot: smoke-check triggered by @Maria G — job:syd2-smoke v4 started (logs: https://ci/internal/1234). ETA 12m.

Jordan P: Quick note on canary traffic split — can we temporarily reduce to 20% until fallback is tenant-aware? Less blast radius.

Maria G: Yes, please reduce to 20%. Kevin/Jordan coordinate on policy change, then we bump back up.

privacy-team: KMS review: need one small change to the IAM binding to prevent cross-tenant key aliases. Will post exact binding snippet in 10m.

net-eng: Egress looks stable for 40m now, no ephemeral churn observed.

Kevin L: PR updated, added tenant-aware flag and unit tests. Link: https://go/internal/policies/syd2-fallback-pr. Jordan, PTAL.

Jordan P: LGTM with one inline comment. Not blocking.

Maria G: Solid. Timeline recap — reduce canary to 20% now, privacy finalizes KMS binding, net-eng confirms steady egress, ops-bot will rerun smoke after PR merged. If all green, target full rollout tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

Kevin L: Merging PR in 5.

ops-bot: build succeeded and smoke re-run passed. summary: latency 95p under SLO, token-cost within expected.

Maria G: Thanks everyone — will post final cutover plan in #eng-platform tomorrow 08:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

Jordan P: One more: tagging infra-owners in the cutover doc so oncall sees the change.

Maria G: Done, linked in the doc. End of thread.
